The title indicates an account of the past deeds and spiritual attainment of the elder Sīhāsanadāyaka. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].

It also exhibits standard stock verse parallels with several other Therāpadāna poems, including the *Khomadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 32), *Sakacintaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 63), *Bhikkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 103), *Sopākattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 21), *Ekatthambhikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 14), and *Vidhūpanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 53) [DharmaNexus].
